verdicts.note: The prompt asked which greedy algorithm finds a minimum spanning tree, but Prim's algorithm (mentioned in the card's own tip) also fits. Title now asks for Kruskal's algorithm by name, so only one answer fits.

The resonance rule said to multiply the guess by n only when the whole guess solves the homogeneous recurrence. For a constant or polynomial f with 1 as a characteristic root only part of the guess does. Wording now covers this case.
Watch-out about deleting an interior vertex of a path in a tree was ambiguous. Replaced with the precise statement: deleting a vertex of degree at least 2 disconnects a tree.
Tip used the term lattice path, which is not taught. Removed.
Subgraph was used without being introduced. Added a short parenthetical definition.
Rule-of-thumb claim that this is the most common exam error is unsupported. Softened to a very common error.
